Coram : R. SUBHASH REDDY*, HRISHIKESH ROY
Penal Code, 1860 – s.306 – Deceased (brother of complainant) went to the house of appellant and consumed poison by taking out from a small bottle which he carried in his pocket – Proceedings against appellant u/s.306, IPC and 3(2)(v) of the SC and ST Act – High of appellant u/s.482, CrPC – On appeal, held: Merely because deceased consumed poison in front of the house of the appellant, that itself will not indicate any relation of the appellant with the deceased – Absolutely no material to allege that appellant abetted for suicide of the
